prompt:
A clean, straight-on photo of a single retail SHELF holding FOUR product slots side by side, numbered 1 to 4 from LEFT to right (the slot number printed under each slot). Each slot holds a vertical STACK of identical product boxes standing on the shelf; the number of boxes in a slot is its facing count. The shelf has a maximum capacity of 5 boxes per slot -- a slot can never hold more than 5 boxes.

At the start of the day the slots hold, from slot 1 to slot 4: 3, 5, 2, 4 boxes. During the day these stock events happen, in this exact order. 'Sell N' removes N boxes from that slot (a slot can go no lower than 0). 'Restock N' adds N boxes to that slot, but the slot is capped at 5 -- any boxes beyond 5 do not fit and are not added.
  1. Sell slot 2, 3 facings.
  2. Restock slot 3, 4 facings.
  3. Sell slot 4, 1 facing.
  4. Restock slot 1, 1 facing.
  5. Sell slot 3, 2 facings.
  6. Restock slot 2, 2 facings.

Work out how many boxes remain in EACH of the four slots at the END of the day, then draw the shelf in that final state: for each slot, draw a vertical stack of exactly that many identical boxes standing on the shelf, with the slot numbers 1 to 4 under them. Respecting the cap of 5, no stack may be taller than 5 boxes. Do not print any count numbers, the event list, or any arithmetic on the shelf -- show the remaining stock only as the HEIGHT of each stack of boxes.
easy_question: This picture was supposed to show a retail shelf holding a number of product slots side by side, each slot a vertical stack of product boxes, with slot numbers printed underneath. Never mind how well it is drawn. Does the picture show a shelf of stacked product boxes in numbered slots? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of that shown, or something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_grid: the height of each of the 4 product slots read left to right (slot 1 first), giving for each slot the NUMBER of product boxes in its stack (count the boxes drawn standing in that slot)
reference.q_nslots: How many product slots (side-by-side stacks of boxes) are on the shelf? Give a whole number only.

steps.target: one upright stack of product boxes standing in its own numbered slot on the shelf

steps.read_crop: Does this picture show ONE whole upright stack of product boxes standing in a single slot, rather than bare shelf or only part of a stack? Answer yes or no only.
